subject: ADR-179: the .eco Reference says what the parser reads -- the grammar page held to ExperimentSpec's source, corrected and republished, its own examples run as one protocol
body: THE GRAMMAR PAGE, HELD TO THE GRAMMAR. eco-protocol-reference.html named a metric the engine lacks (dispersion), an operator it refuses (=), band words it never uses (even / uneven, random / regular / clumped), six of nine models, and a header example the parser rejects (three directives on one line). Corrected: all nine models with the parser's argument order; metrics richness shannon evenness hill1 chao1 and pairwise brayCurtis jaccard sorensen pianka; operators < > <= >= with = named as absent; the five qualitative metrics with their exact bands and arities; the header one directive per line; the example gains turnover(graze, bloom) is major. Republished (c54e14b5), stamped, swept, 42 of 42 measured. NEW verify_epr (46): the grammar read from ExperimentSpec.java (arity switch, operators, wordsFor, parseModel counts, phase shapes, factors, directives) and the page held to it both ways; the page's examples accepted alone and assembled in page order as one protocol the engine grades (no problem line, seven graded, the deliberate one refuted, survivorship type3); the lab's importer reads it with zero problems. Not done: the lab importer's own band lists; dwc: undocumented.
